question: The present age of Noman thrice the present time of Shamim who is 20. How many years ago was the age of Noman five times that of shamim?
explanation:
🔖Lets say, Noman's age was five times of Shamim's age X years ago and their present ages are N and S respectivety.
So, N = 3S =3×20 = 60 years.
Now, five years ago,
N - X = 5(S-X)
or, 60 - X = 5(20 - X)
or, 60 - X = 100 - 5X
or, 5X - X = 100 - 60
or, 4X = 40
or, X = 10 years

question: A father is three time old as old as his son. After fifteen years the will be twice as old as his sons age at that time. Hence the fathers present age-
explanation:
🔖Let the ages of the father and his son be F and S respectively.
Now, F = 3S or, S = F/3
After 15 years, F + 15 = 2(S + 15)
or, F + 15 = 2S + 30
or, F - 2S = 30 - 15
or, F - 2(F/3) = 15
or, (3F - 2F)/3 = 15
or, F = 15 x 3 = 45
